title: Studio intake
description: video/<slug>/studio/intake.json. Written once by the studio when the user sends the Intake form; the session the project is assigned to starts Intake from it.

brief.description: What the user wants: a draft, a prompt or an idea.

specs.description: Runtime, size, frame rate and the like; empty means Claude asks or defaults.

profile.description: null leaves the choice to Claude at Intake.

brand.description: A local path to brand material; may be empty.

assets.description: Local paths to source material; v1 has no uploads.
